questions.question: You have a React + Vite project with a 3D portfolio scene. What is the fastest way to deploy it to a live, public URL?
options: Connect the GitHub repository to Vercel and let it auto-detect the Vite build
Export the Vite project as a .zip and upload it to a file hosting service
Use gltf-transform to generate a standalone HTML file
Convert the React project to vanilla JavaScript first, then use GitHub Pages
questions.explanation: Vercel auto-detects Vite projects, runs `npm run build`, and deploys to a live URL typically in under 2 minutes. Connecting a GitHub repo takes less than 5 minutes total.

questions.question: For continuing to learn GLSL shaders after this course, which resource is most directly useful?
options: Mixamo - for advanced shader-based rigging techniques
Shadertoy - a community browser where you can read and fork thousands of GLSL shaders
Meshy.ai - which generates shader code from text prompts
gltf-transform - which has a shader optimization module
questions.explanation: Shadertoy (shadertoy.com) is a browser-based GLSL playground with a massive community of shader experiments you can view, learn from, and fork.

questions.question: Which capstone project option does NOT require a 3D model file (GLB) as input?
options: Option A - 3D Portfolio Hero with animated character
Option B - Product Configurator with color switching
Option C - Mini Browser Game with sphere and collectibles
Both Options A and B require model files but not C
questions.explanation: Option C (the mini browser game) uses only built-in Three.js primitives - a PlaneGeometry for the ground, SphereGeometry for the player, and BoxGeometry for collectibles. No external 3D model is needed.

questions.question: What is the recommended next course for learning advanced Three.js after completing this course?
options: Blender Guru's tutorials - the best starting point for advanced Three.js
Shadertoy community workshops - focused on shader techniques only
Mixamo documentation - for advanced animation and rendering
Three.js Journey by Bruno Simon - the gold-standard comprehensive Three.js course
questions.explanation: Three.js Journey (threejs-journey.com) by Bruno Simon is widely considered the gold standard for comprehensive Three.js learning, covering fundamentals through advanced shaders, physics, and post-processing.

questions.question: Before deploying your capstone project, which optimization step should you do for any 3D model files?
options: Upload the model to Mixamo to verify it loads correctly
Run npx gltf-transform optimize to compress geometry and reduce file size
Convert GLB to OBJ format for better browser compatibility
Export from Blender again with lower-resolution settings
questions.explanation: Running `npx gltf-transform optimize input.glb output.glb --draco` before deploying applies Draco mesh compression and other optimizations, reducing file size and improving load times for mobile users.
